<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a sulfonamide formation template. The forward reaction forms an S‑N bond and breaks an S‑Cl bond, converting a sulfonyl chloride and an amine into a sulfonamide. Use these bond changes as criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(c2ccc(O)cc2)(c2ccc(O)cc2)c2ccccc21",
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
